title: Mexican Pork Ribs
description: A twist on traditional pork ribs, these Mexican-style ribs are slow-cooked in a flavorful chipotle tomato sauce.

ingredients.name: pork ribs
ingredients.notes: baby back or St. Louis style

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together chipotle peppers, ketchup, brown sugar, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Place pork ribs in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot. Brush the chipotle-ketchup mixture evenly over both sides of the ribs.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven. Bake for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, remove the pot from the oven and carefully brush the ribs with additional chipotle-ketchup mixture, if desired.
Return the pot to the oven and bake for an additional 30 minutes, or until the ribs are caramelized and slightly charred.
Remove the pot from the oven and let the ribs rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
Serve the ribs with additional chipotle-ketchup sauce for dipping, if desired.
